description: Set the daily budget (in account currency, e.g. USD) on a campaign or ad squad. Refused above the absolute limit (SNAP_MAX_DAILY_BUDGET), above the allowed increase per step and per 24 hours (default +100%), and below the minimum. Previews unless confirm=true. Two steps: confirm=false returns a preview and an approval_token; to apply, repeat the same arguments with confirm=true and that approval_token.

approval_token.description: The approval_token returned by the preview of this exact request. Required with confirm=true.

confirm.description: false = preview only (nothing sent). true = apply; needs approval_token from the preview.

name: snap_set_daily_budget
